title: Contact hours
content: Customers may only be contacted between 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM local time.

title: Contact frequency
content: A customer may be contacted at most 3 times per week across all channels.

title: Preferred channel
content: Use the customer's preferred channel first. Do not switch channels without a reason.

title: No threats
content: Messages must be polite. Threats, shaming and false claims of legal action are not allowed.

title: Hardship handling
content: If the customer reports hardship, offer a payment plan discussion and do not escalate before human review.

title: Payment plan offer
content: A payment plan may be offered when the customer cannot pay in full. Minimum first payment is 25% of the overdue amount.

title: Broken promise
content: After a broken promise, follow up within 3 days and offer a revised plan before escalating.

title: Escalation rule
content: Escalate to a human officer after 60 days overdue or 2 broken promises.

title: Privacy
content: Do not share account details with anyone other than the customer. Do not include full account numbers in messages.

title: Human approval
content: Every recommended action must be reviewed and approved by a human officer before it is sent.
